tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung pod/(kha) 001 rgyun khyer gyi bsangs yig bsdus pa la/ 002 rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba la/ yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad la/ bla ma la gsol 'debs phur tshugs la/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan la bstod pa/ shar pa ye shes bzang po la bstod pa la sogs pa bstod pa khag mang po bzhugs so// 003 bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bde mchog dril bu pa sa lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba'i bla ma brgyud pa/ rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma'i kha bskong / rigs lnga'i khyab bdag ma'i kha skong / tshe dpag med lha dgu la/ kun rig la/ kun khyab 'khor lo ma'i kha skong / lam zab brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong / blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs bcas la/ 004 gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad/ ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo la bstod pa mngon rtogs rab gsal/ rdo rje 'char kun dga' bzang po'i phyi rten bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i mchod rten rnams la gser khebs gsar spos mdzad skabs bsngags brjod/ 005 bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka ha s+ye badz+ra gyis gsung zer 'ga' bdog 006 grags rgyal bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 007 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa mkha' spyod lam bzang zhes bya ba la/ 008 dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ 009 lta sgom 'bel gtam byung ba'i brjed tho/ 010 rnal 'byor ma'i ku sā la'i tshogs bsags kyi ngag 'don/ 011 nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba/ 012 rnal 'byor mar nyer mkho'i reg zig 013

rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug 014 rnal 'byor ma'i sngags don la gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsung lan/ 015 gnas lugs sgom pa'i lhan thabs yid kyi mun sel bi dza ha ra/ 016 'khrid kyi snying po gnas lugs gcer mthong gi man ngag 017 rgad po mdzub btsugs kyi gdams ngag 018 kye rdor mngon rtogs lam dus la nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris/ 019 gzhal yas khang gi phyag tshad mdor bsdus/ 020 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu la/ 021 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu las gnad don rags pa bsdus pa la/ 022 skyer sgang lugs kyi yi ge drug pa'i nyer mkho cung zad gcig 023 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed/ 024 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed las/ sgrub pa'i skabs kyi cho ga ye shes rab rgyas/ 025 gtor bsngo brgya rtsa sogs byed pa'i phyag len 'dod don lhun grub/ 026 thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tho yig 027 thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le la/ 028 spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i tshigs bcad dang / gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs/ 029 thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'phrin las rab rgyas/ 030 gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang / 031 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i srung ba rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid nyams su blang tshul gyi brjed byang bdud dpung tshar gcod la/ 032 dpal gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tho/ 033 mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'i sdom la/

034 gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid 'chad par tho yig gnad kyi lde mig 035 lam 'bras 'chad skabs kyi tho chung / 036 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg me shel rab 'bar/ 037 bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsal byed/ 038 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi zur 'debs dang po'i las can dga' byed/ 039 gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ 040 paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis kyi cho ga'i tho yig nyin byed snang ba la brten nas gri gug lha lnga sin+dhu ra la brten pa snyan brgyud lugs dang / mgon po lha bcu bdun gyi dbang gi phyag len zur 'debs/ 041 dam can chos rgyal 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang gi spyi bshad mdor bsdus/ 042 tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sbyin sreg bar chad kun sel/ 043 rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub/ 044 sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 045 sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zur 'debs/ 046 dpal mgon stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi bskang gso'i cho ga lag len rab gsal 'phrin las myur 'grub/ 047 dpal nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ 048 dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ 049 rnam sras kyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ 050 bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i gtor bsngo khyer bde/ 051 rgyal kun gsung rab snying po mkha' 'gro yi/ 052 bdag dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis 'khrul snang rmi lam sna tshogs las/ 053 rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang bcas bzhugs so//
